Defaults external finding offsets to Unicode code points

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const result = try xberg.extract_with_external_redaction("{\"bytes\":[90,111,195,171,120,32,101,109,97,105,108,101,100,46],\"filename\":\"external-findings-default.txt\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\"}", "{}", "[{\"entity_type\":\"inspection_person\",\"start\":0,\"end\":3,\"score\":0.99,\"analysis_explanation\":{\"recognizer\":\"spacy\"}}]", null, 8);
    std.debug.print("{any}\n", .{ result.results[0].content });
}
```
